name: PCI DSS v4.0 (requirement level)
publisher: PCI Security Standards Council (summarised by AEGIS)
licenseNote: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard is published by the PCI Security Standards Council. AEGIS references the twelve principal requirement numbers only; every title and summary is original AEGIS wording describing the objective and is not the text of the standard. PCI DSS compliance is validated by qualified assessors; nothing in AEGIS is or substitutes for that.
description: The twelve principal requirements of PCI DSS v4.0 for organizations that store, process or transmit cardholder data, with the AEGIS records that can evidence the ones an AI agent touches (access, logging, monitoring, and what leaves the environment).

controls.title: Network security controls
controls.summary: Network controls restrict traffic into and out of the cardholder data environment and between its components.
controls.category: Build and maintain a secure network and systems

controls.title: Secure configurations
controls.summary: System components are configured securely and vendor defaults, including default credentials, are changed before use.
controls.category: Build and maintain a secure network and systems

controls.title: Protect stored account data
controls.summary: Stored account data is minimised, retained only as needed, and rendered unreadable, and sensitive authentication data is never stored after authorisation.

controls.title: Protect cardholder data in transit
controls.summary: Cardholder data sent over open or public networks is protected with strong cryptography.

controls.title: Protect against malicious software
controls.summary: Systems are protected against malware and the protections are kept current, monitored and acted on.

controls.title: Secure systems and software
controls.summary: Software is developed securely, vulnerabilities are identified and patched, and changes to system components are managed.

controls.title: Restrict access by business need to know
controls.summary: Access to system components and cardholder data is limited to the people and services whose job requires it, including automated agents.

controls.title: Identify users and authenticate access
controls.summary: Every user and service has a unique identity, is authenticated strongly, and credentials are managed over their life cycle.

controls.title: Restrict physical access
controls.summary: Physical access to cardholder data and the systems that hold it is controlled and monitored.

controls.title: Log and monitor all access
controls.summary: Access to system components and cardholder data is logged, logs are protected from alteration, reviewed and retained.

controls.title: Test security regularly
controls.summary: Vulnerabilities are scanned, penetration tests performed, and changes and intrusions detected through regular testing and monitoring.

controls.title: Support information security with policies and programs
controls.summary: An information security policy, risk assessment, awareness program, third-party management and an incident response plan are maintained and tested.
